Summary:

Mojito House



The Space:

Come soak in the sweet sun and bask in relaxation on the sand when you book your next escape to this Dune Allen Beach home. Featuring a private pool, stress-melting master soaking bathtub, and a convenient central location, this home surrounds you with chances for relaxation and adventure.



Less than half-a-mile to Dune Allen Beach and about a mile to the Stallworth Nature Preserve, you'll be nestled in a quiet neighborhood while having easy access to local attractions and the pristine Florida beaches. Use the two provided bicycles to get around town, or hop in the car and drive down 30A to explore nearby attractions.



Upgraded hardwood floors, contemporary accents, and a family-friendly style give this spacious three-level home the perfect atmosphere for relaxation. Put a load of laundry in the private washer/dryer then lounge on the couch and catch up with a good book. Check out what's on cable or pop in your favorite DVD to enjoy a movie night on the flatscreen TV.



Leave the cool central A/C when you step just outside for the gentle ocean breezes on the deck and listen to some tunes streaming from the iPod dock. Connect to the WiFi to check the forecast before your next adventure. Use the gas BBQ to grill up some fresh shrimp as an appetizer before starting on the main dish.



Have a culinary assistant chop some herbs at the breakfast bar while you put the electric range and stainless steel appliances to work. With custom stone counters and a microwave, you'll be able to keep everyone fed and happy with ease. Dine at the chic wooden table, or take the food outside to dine al fresco!



As the day slowly fades away, this four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home has room for up to 12 guests with ease. In the master bedroom on the middle level, you'll be greeted by a queen-size bed, direct deck access, sitting area, and private en suite with luxurious soaking tub.



The ground level has two bedrooms, both with queen-size beds, that share a full Jack-and-Jill bathroom. The fourth room, upstairs on the third level, has a twin-over-double bunk bed with a pull-out twin trundle. This upper level also has a kitchenette perfect for making quick snacks, as well as a sitting area with a TV and fantastic gulf views. If you need more space there is a sofabed as well.



Wake up early and be on time for the boat ride when you book your trip on a deep-sea fishing tour. Cast out with the expert guides and bring home a fresh fish for dinner for everyone to enjoy. Take some time to walk the trails and explore the beauty of the Topsail Hill Preserve and paddle through Campbell Lake with a kayak or stand-up paddleboard.



Spend a day basking in the sun on the pristine sands of Dune Allen Beach. Head back to your place to catch some rays poolside while the kids splash and play some games in the pool. Treat everyone to a night out and fresh seafood dinner at the enduring local favorite Goatfeathers Seafood Restaurant. Finish the day with a long stroll on the beach as the sun sets.



Surround yourself with tranquility and chances for fun when you book your next trip to this Florida home, and come make your beachside memories.



This property is managed by Vacasa Florida LLC.



* Please contact us for our special Snowbird pricing!



1-day notification is required in order to heat the pool. A fee of USD 50 per day must be paid prior to check-in. Guests can contact us after booking to purchase pool heat for your stay.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
